As an American living in Europe and working in tech, I get asked all the time why I chose to live here instead of the US.

For me, it was never about picking sides, US vs. Europe. It was simply about where the best opportunities were, personally and professionally. That's why today's Forbes announcement of EWOR's new US Leadership team feels personal.

What I love about EWOR is that our team always does what's best for our fellows, full stop. Right now, and going forward, that means building out our US presence: closer support for our founders there, and a way in for EWOR Fellows building everywhere else.
